payment_column_types.sql: select column_name, type_name, column_size, is_nullable from information_schema.system_columns where table_name = 'PAYMENT' order by ordinal_position

payment_rows_after_seed.sql: select * from PAYMENT where payment_id > 60 or claim_id = 1 order by payment_id

payment_totals.sql: select count(*) as payment_count, max(payment_id) as max_payment_id from PAYMENT

settlements_used.sql: select settlement_id, claim_id, settlement_amount from SETTLEMENT where claim_id in (1, 119, 120) order by settlement_id
